title: Colocalizing subcategories on differentially graded algebras
summary: Let $A$ be a bounded non positive commutative differential graded algebra $A$. Let $\mathbf{D}(A)$ its derived category of DG-modules. If $\mathbf{D}(A)$ is generated by the DG-modules corresponding to the residue fields of the ordinary ring $H^0(A)$ then its localizing subcategories and its colocalizing subcategories are in bijection with the subsets of $\textrm{Spec}(H^0(A))$. These results generalize well-known theorems by A. Neeman (from 1992 and 2011, respectively), because any Noetherian ring satisfies this condition.
